annotation.title_clean: AI Readiness and Maturity Framework for Rwanda
annotation.title_en: AI Readiness and Maturity Framework for Rwanda
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Rwanda Ministry of ICT and Innovation (MINICT); Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution Rwanda (C4IR); GIZ FAIR Forward; GFA Consulting Group
annotation.summary_en: Report presenting Rwanda's data-driven AI Readiness and Maturity Assessment Framework and dashboard for monitoring implementation of the National AI Policy, with first-round findings on skills, infrastructure, data strategy, public and private sector adoption, and ethics, plus recommendations. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Framework with dashboard of about 50 indicators benchmarks Rwanda against Oxford, Stanford and Tortoise AI indexes
Rwanda ranks 10th in Africa on the Oxford AI Index
Recommends data stewardship training and better data access and partnerships
Recommends building AI capacity in government and increasing AI skills and cloud compute access
Framework can be scaled to other African countries under the AI for Africa blueprint
